source.citation: B. Azadegan, W. Wagner and J. Pawelke, Phys. Rev. B 74, 045209 (2006)
source.method: Tables II-V transcribed from the PDF text layer (pp. 045209-7 to -9); same values as the 2026-10-15 audit in docs/validation/channeling/cr-line-shape.md

beam.note: Initial divergence about 0.1 mrad; energy spread RMS/FWHM not stated; electron energy convention (kinetic vs total) not stated, see cr-line-shape.

detector.type: CdTe, on axis, 3.3 m, 1 mm aperture

width_definition: Gamma_exp is the FWHM of the fitted asymmetric profile (Eq. 23) and includes detector resolution, Bloch dispersion and in-plane multiple scattering; Gamma_T is its Lorentzian parameter. No uncertainties given.
notes: theta_ms_ch is the effective RMS in-plane multiple-scattering angle from the line-shape asymmetry fit (Table II), about 0.55 of the amorphous Eq. (18) value at 42.5 um and growing roughly as L^0.37 in alpha^2.
Table VI coherence lengths are internally inconsistent with Table V by about a factor of two (cr-line-shape audit); they are not transcribed.
